BEHIND YOU
STOU GAMES

Aristotle's
Labyrinth

🎯Objective: escape the labyrinth before Aristotle catches you — he's philosophical about it, but he never stops, even when your back is turned.
🏃Survive: keep moving and use helpful items — Speed, Shield, Freeze Ray, Score Cache — and the toy pistol (auto-granted) to slow him down.
🔥Flame Burst: automatically becomes available every 20 seconds — no pickup needed. Hit the FLAME button (or press F) while Aristotle is close to set him ablaze and knock him down. You only get to use it once per game, so make it count!
✨Find the way out: follow the glowing neon wall arrows — a fresh trail every game — which fade behind you as you pass.
🚪Win: walk through the glowing exit door to escape successfully!

WASD to move & strafe · Arrows to move & turn · drag to look · Space to fire
